name: Front
oneLiner: Customer operations platform that combines shared inboxes for email, chat, SMS and social with helpdesk ticketing, automation and AI agents.
bestFor: Teams that handle a lot of customer email and messaging and want helpdesk structure without leaving an email-style workflow.

updates.text: Front launched Autopilot, an omnichannel AI agent that resolves customer conversations under admin-set controls, sold as an add-on at $0.89 per resolution with a 14-day free trial.
Front opened a beta that lets external AI agents work inside Front as teammates, with assigned conversations, their own identity and handoffs to humans.

features: Shared inboxes for email, SMS, live chat (Front Chat) and social messages
Assignment, internal comments and @mentions on conversations
Rules and workflows for routing, follow-ups and escalation
Autopilot AI agent and Copilot AI drafting for agents
Analytics on response times, SLA adherence and workload
Integrations such as Salesforce, Slack and Aircall
AI Topics: the most common reasons customers get in touch
Smart QA and Smart CSAT: AI scorecards and satisfaction scores inferred without surveys
External AI agents (built with Claude, Codex, Sierra and others) can work in Front alongside the team

pricing.text: Billed annually (save 24%): Starter $25/seat/month (up to 10 seats, single channel type, up to 10 automation rules); Professional $65/seat/month (up to 50 seats, omnichannel, up to 20 rules); Enterprise $105/seat/month (unlimited rules, AI Copilot, QA and CSAT included). Add-ons: Autopilot AI agent from $0.05 per conversation (talk to sales); Copilot $20/seat/month on Starter and Professional. 14-day free trial of Professional features, no credit card. An onboarding package is required for contracts over $25k.

notes: Front's domain is now front.com (original review links front.app; kept as required). front.com could not be fetched; pricing from search snippets of front.com/pricing and Front's 2026 blog posts (one Front article says $27, so worth re-checking). Old $19/seat Starter price (2023 tiers) is outdated. Copilot add-on price ($20/seat per third party) not verified, left out of review. November 2026: front.com/pricing fetched directly with curl. Autopilot is now listed 'Starting at $0.05 /conversation' with 'Talk to sales' (the $0.89 per resolution in the 2025-09 update was the launch price). Monthly-billing prices aren't shown. front.app redirects to front.com. G2 rating (4.7, 2,499 reviews) from G2 search result snippets; G2 blocked fetching.
pros: Email-style workflow with helpdesk structure: assignment, comments, SLAs
Omnichannel on Professional and Enterprise: email, SMS, social, WhatsApp and chat in one place
Choice of AI: Autopilot, Copilot and external AI agents
14-day free trial without a credit card

cons.text: Starter is limited to a single channel type; omnichannel starts on Professional at $65 per seat
Priced per seat, so cost grows with the team
AI costs extra below Enterprise: Copilot is $20 per seat per month, Autopilot is billed per conversation
An onboarding package is required for contracts over $25k
No free plan, only a 14-day trial
